description: Timing point 2 (R peak + parabolic + guard) with the per-beat correlation check, and the HRV cleaning rules. Read by pan_tompkins.py; BeatDetector.kt hard-codes the same values and BeatDetectorConfigTest asserts they match this file.
tuned_on: Development data only: the 12-record MIT-BIH subset in data/mitdb (100 101 103 105 106 108 109 119 203 208 222 228) and the dual capture 20260929_163314_dual03. The Pan-Tompkins core (thresholds, search-back, refractory, T-wave rule, stall decay) is fixed in code and was also developed on that subset.

heldout_protocol.records: the 36 MIT-BIH Arrhythmia records not in the development subset, downloaded once, evaluated once
heldout_protocol.lead: MLII wherever the record has it (record 114 has it on channel 1); otherwise channel 0. The other channel is lead 1 for the three-cornered hat.
heldout_protocol.paced_records: 102 104 107 217 are reported separately, as ANSI/AAMI EC57 excludes paced records from the main figures
heldout_protocol.variants: both reported from the same single run: tp2 (CORR_MIN off) and tp2.1 (CORR_MIN as above)
heldout_protocol.metrics: EC57 Se and P+ ungated and with the bSQI 0.9 gate plus its rejection rate; timing spread against annotations; RMSSD error against annotations, each with its coverage
heldout_protocol.rule: no parameter in this file is changed in response to held-out results
